subject: Symphony x Redwood: co-hosted APAC demo — availability + fallback runbook
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nimbus-systems.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Timothy Baker <timothy.baker@aws-partner.com>, Asha Menon <asha.menon@symphony.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Symphony x Redwood — co-hosted APAC demo availability + fallback runbook

Hi Logan / Karthik —

Thanks again for agreeing to co-host a joint demo with Symphony for the APAC pilot customers. We want to lock a time that works for the APAC SI stakeholders and AWS SEs, and — importantly — confirm a lightweight fallback runbook in case we hit region capacity or streaming latency issues.

High-level asks from our side:
- Proposed windows: Aug 17 (0900–1100 SGT) or Aug 19 (1300–1500 SGT). Please confirm which you can support.
- Can Redwood provide a warm standby model variant (quantized) in a secondary region and an auto-failover policy? We want to call this out in the runbook.
- Attach: draft runbook + slide deck we plan to use (placeholders). Any preferred changes to the deck?

If we can get tentative confirmations by EOD Friday PST, we’ll lock invites and start a 1-hour dry run the week prior.

Thanks —
Elena
Partner Ops, Nimbus Systems
(attachment: runbook-dryrun-checklist.pdf)
(attachment: cohost-demo-slide-deck-v2.pptx)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nimbus-systems.com>
Cc: Timothy Baker <timothy.baker@aws-partner.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Symphony x Redwood — co-hosted APAC demo availability + fallback runbook

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Both windows work for Redwood in principle, but two quick notes:

- Aug 17 (0900 SGT) is tight for our SEs — they have an internal enablement at 0900 SGT; we can still do it if we shift the demo start to 1000 SGT.
- Aug 19 (1300 SGT) looks cleaner from our calendar side and gives more runway for a dry run on Aug 16.

About the warm standby: yes — we can provision a quantized variant in ap-southeast-1 as a standby and configure an automatic soft-failover (route to standby if p95 latency > 800ms for 30s). That would add ~15 minutes to the cutover checklist. Vanessa, can your team confirm the autoscaling window required for a standby?

I reviewed the deck quickly — a couple of suggestions inline in the attached (minor copy tweaks on the architecture slide). I’ll pencil in Aug 19 1300–1400 SGT as the preferred slot; if you need the extra hour we can extend to 1500.

— Logan
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nimbus-systems.com>, Timothy Baker <timothy.baker@aws-partner.com>, Asha Menon <asha.menon@symphony.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 06:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Symphony x Redwood — co-hosted APAC demo availability + fallback runbook

Looping in operational details and a compact fallback runbook. Quick summary below; full checklist attached.

Operational asks (Redwood ops):
- Standby variant: ap-southeast-1 quantized instance (estimated 2x small GPU nodes for warm KV state).
- Autoscale trigger: p95 token latency > 800ms for 30s -> scale + spawn standby.
- Fallback routing policy: soft-fail to standby, then to hosted API (read-only) after 2 failed attempts.
- Communication: throw a Slack alert to #partners-runbook and page on-call if failover occurs.

Dry-run plan (Aug 16):
- 30m ops rehearsal (failover simulation)
- 30m end-to-end run with Symphony demo flow

Attachments: runbook-dryrun-checklist.pdf (detailed step-by-step), cohost-demo-slide-deck-v2.pptx (final with ops notes).

A couple of cross-team asks:
- Timothy / AWS: can you confirm any marketplace listing demos require a separate marketplace preview account? If so, we need that provisioned before Aug 16.
- Karthik: please add the runbook to the Redwood Console shared folder and set a 24-hour retention for the rehearsal traces.

If everyone agrees, Logan — please send the calendar invites and include the rehearsal playbook as a calendar attachment.

— Vanessa
Sr. Partner Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Timothy Baker <timothy.baker@aws-partner.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@nimbus-systems.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Asha Menon <asha.menon@symphony.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Symphony x Redwood — co-hosted APAC demo availability + fallback runbook

All — thanks for the detail. Confirming:
- AWS can provision a marketplace preview account for Symphony by Aug 12 if you share the portal contact (Elena, can you DM me the Symphony admin email?).
- Aug 19 1300–1400 SGT locked for the customer demo; Aug 16 1000–1100 SGT locked for the dry run (timing shifted per Logan).
- I reviewed the runbook PDF; small ask to call out the DocuSign link for the demo NDA in step 1 (I added a comment).

One operational note: if the trial tenant needs elevated logging retention during the demo, we can extend to 48 hours for this run — notify me by Aug 14.

See you on the dry run — I’ll join with an AWS SE and bring the marketplace preview contact details.

— Timothy
Senior Partner Manager — AWS Marketplace
